records.title: KIIT University India Scholarships Programme (KUISP)
records.official_source: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) Deemed to be University
records.deadline_display: No current official deadline could be retrieved. The KUISP leaflets for recent cycles stated "Application Start Date: 1st March" and "Application Deadline: 30th August" for that academic year, with applications free of charge. The equivalent window for the current academic year has already passed on the verification date.
records.application_period: Annual. Recent cycles opened on 1 March and closed at the end of August of the same year, with Indian diplomatic missions also asked to recommend candidates by 30 September.
